svg.title: Port definition with ports compartment
svg.desc: A separated ports compartment with two editable literal rows and an elision marker. Fixed two-row layout, one selected compartment, no automatic parsing, wrapping or row generation. Names, prefixes and inherited/conjugated declarations remain the caller’s responsibility; this does not render every compartment-stack alternative.
